title: Blood Donation Camp 2026
details: Annual blood donation camp organized by NSS IIT Patna in collaboration with local hospitals. We successfully collected over 200 units of blood to help patients in need.

title: Village Cleanliness Drive
details: A massive cleanliness drive was organized in the nearby Amhara village under the Swachh Bharat Abhiyan. Over 50 volunteers participated in raising awareness and cleaning the surroundings.

title: Education Outreach Program
details: Weekly education outreach program for the underprivileged children near the campus. Volunteers taught basic science and mathematics concepts through interactive activities.

title: World Environment Day - Tree Plantation
details: Planted 500 saplings across the campus and neighboring areas to promote a greener environment. The event saw participation from students and faculty alike.

title: Yoga and Mental Health Workshop
details: A session focusing on mental well-being, stress relief, and physical fitness through yoga, guided by professional instructors.

title: Computer Literacy Workshop
details: NSS volunteers conducted a basic computer skills and internet safety workshop for children of local government schools.

title: Winter Clothes Distribution Drive
details: NSS IIT Patna organized a donation drive collecting and distributing warm clothes to underprivileged families in nearby areas.

title: Health Check-up Campaign for Safai Mitras
details: Part of the Swachhata Hi Seva (Day 4) campaign. A basic health screening and awareness drive focused on personal health, hygiene, and essential health guidance for campus safai mitras and support workers.
images: events/2026-2027/Prerna/Health Check-up Campaign for Safai Mitras/

title: Swachhata Hi Seva Cleanliness Drive 02
details: The second day of the two-day campus-wide cleanliness campaign (स्वच्छता अभियान) aimed at promoting environmental responsibility.

title: Swachhata Hi Seva Cleanliness Drive 01
details: The initial leg of the campus cleanliness drive organized by volunteers to keep the surroundings clean.

title: Swachhata Hi Seva: School Activities & Sessions
details: As part of the first two days of the campaign, volunteers visited schools in Amhara and Raghopur. They conducted Swachhata awareness sessions, demonstrated proper hand-cleaning, and organized hands-on activities focusing on wet and dry waste segregation.
images: events/2026-2027/Teaching/Swachhata Hi Seva - School Activities & Sessions/

title: Swachhta Hi Seva Pledge Ceremony
details: A formal ceremony for the campus community to take a pledge reaffirming their commitment to cleanliness and a greener environment.

title: Mental Health Awareness Session
details: An interactive session led by IIT Patna Counselor, Mr. Aditya Sahu. It focused on emotional well-being, breaking the stigma around seeking help, and building a supportive community.

title: Scholarship Awareness Session
details: A dedicated seminar for the new batch to help them navigate eligibility criteria, documentation, and application processes for various government, private, and institute-based scholarships.

title: Comprehensive Rural Survey
details: Volunteers conducted a door-to-door survey in a nearby village to assess the residents' access to basic facilities and better understand their everyday challenges.

title: Blood & Platelet Donation Camp
details: Organized in collaboration with Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Medical College (NSMCH) and TAL Blood Aid, this camp mobilized students to donate blood, with chief guest Mr. Veeshwajeet Kashid supporting the initiative.

title: Blood & Platelet Donation Awareness Session
details: A prelude to the donation camp, featuring a talk by Mr. Veeshwajeet Kashid that highlighted the life-saving impact of voluntary blood and platelet donations.

title: Independence Day Tiranga Rally
details: Over 300 students participated in an early morning campus rally under the "Har Ghar Tiranga" campaign to celebrate freedom, unity, and the spirit of service.

title: Project Suraksha: Mosquito Prevention Drive
details: Volunteers distributed mosquito repellents, creams, and coils across the campus community while raising awareness about preventing mosquito-borne illnesses.

title: Spiritual Session: Taming the Turbulent Mind
details: An interactive session held in collaboration with the Bhakti Vedanta Club (BVC). Dr. Ranjan Kumar Behera discussed mindfulness, spirituality, and mind control drawing from the Bhagavad Gita.
